questions.question: Temple of Doom is set in which year relative to Raiders of the Lost Ark?
questions.note: Temple is 1935; Raiders is 1936. It is a prequel, even though it was the second film released.

questions.question: In Temple of Doom, what does Indy say he is in it for?
questions.note: He says it to Short Round. By the end he is giving the stone back to the village anyway.

questions.question: Which actor plays Indy’s young sidekick Short Round in Temple of Doom?
questions.note: Ke Huy Quan made his film debut as Short Round. He later won an Oscar for Everything Everywhere All at Once.

questions.question: What sacred objects is Mola Ram after in Temple of Doom?
questions.note: Five legendary stones. Indy returns most of them to the village. Amrish Puri plays Mola Ram.

questions.question: In The Last Crusade, what does Henry Jones Sr. usually call Indy?
questions.note: It drives Ford’s Indy up the wall. Dad is a medieval-literature man with a Grail diary.

questions.question: In The Last Crusade opening, how does young Indy get the scar on his chin?
questions.note: A circus-train chase, then the first fedora.

questions.question: In The Last Crusade, the real Holy Grail looks like what?
questions.note: The knight says “He chose poorly” when Donovan drinks from the flashy one. Indy picks the cup of a carpenter.

questions.question: Which actor plays Indiana Jones’s father in The Last Crusade?
questions.note: Connery plays Professor Henry Jones Sr., whose Grail diary drives the adventure.

questions.question: In The Last Crusade, what does Henry Sr. say they named the family dog?
questions.note: So Indy is named after the dog. Ford’s “This is history” lecture does not survive contact with Dad.

questions.question: At the end of The Last Crusade, what does Indy’s father tell him when Indy is hanging over the chasm for the Grail?
questions.note: Elsa already fell grabbing for it. Indy listens to Dad for once.
